title: Current data_items eval cases are mentions
description:
As an eval reader, I want T0/T1 data_items cases to be named mentions or spans, so that we stop calling a line a data item.

Feature: mention layer name

  Scenario: T1 case is a mention
    Given the existing proposed-gold data_items cases from PR #15
    When I list the mention layer
    Then each case has file and line evidence
    And the layer name is mention or span, not data item

  Scenario: T1 scoring contract still applies
    Given a mention labeled email_address
    And a finding labeled user_email on overlapping lines
    When I score mentions
    Then labelsCorrect is true
